phone_login_code_sent: If this number is registered, a code is on its way.
phone_login_send_failed: Could not send a code. Try again.
phone_login_mfa: This account uses two-step sign-in. Sign in with email and password instead.
phone_login_wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
phone_login_title: Sign in with your phone number
phone_login_number_hint: We will text you a 6-digit code. Standard SMS rates may apply.
phone_login_switch: Sign in with your phone number
sms_pin_failed: Could not save the SMS PIN
sms_pin_locked: Locked after too many wrong PINs. Set a new PIN to unlock.
sms_commands_body: Text INBOX, R 12 <reply>, FIND <name>, VISIT 12 <notes> or ASK AI <question> from {phone}. Send PIN and your 4 digits once a day first.
ai_agronomist_welcome: Ask about a crop, a pest, your soil or the weather. Add a photo of the leaf if you have one. Answers list their sources.
ai_agronomist_recording_toast: Recording. Tap the microphone again to stop.
ai_agronomist_description: Ask about crops, pests, soil and weather. Check any product dose on its label before use.
ai_agronomist_recording: Recording. Tap the microphone again to stop.
ai_agronomist_placeholder: For example: lower maize leaves turning yellow after rain
ai_agronomist_no_sources: The guides behind each answer are listed here.
ai_agronomist_safety: Answers are checked for unsafe doses and mixtures. A diagnosis from a photo needs confirmation by your officer.
billing_config_body: Add the PayPal (or Stripe) keys under Payment keys below. Until then, nobody can pay by card or PayPal.
diagnosis_photo_crop_placeholder: For example maize, coffee or tomato
diagnosis_photo_pick: Take or choose a photo of the leaf
diagnosis_photo_formats: JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB
symptoms_crop_placeholder: For example maize, tomato or coffee
symptoms_what_placeholder: One sign at a time, then Add
field_location_hint: With a location, the field shows on the map and soil data can be looked up for it.
fields_choose_farmer: Choose a farmer to see their fields.
fields_empty_body: Add the first field: its size, soil and where it is.
kb_search_placeholder: For example: fall armyworm in maize, or acid soil at pH 4.8
kb_attach: Attach a leaf photo or a soil test
sms_unicode_note: special characters make each SMS shorter
advisory_saved_error: Saved protocols could not be loaded.
advisory_saved_none: Nothing saved yet. Save a draft to keep it here.
advisory_save_failed: The draft could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
advisory_publish_failed: The protocol could not be published. Try again.
globe_label: Globe with {count} farms. Drag to turn it, scroll or pinch to zoom.
globe_unsupported: This device cannot show the 3D globe. The counts above are the same data.
map_load_failed: The map layers could not be loaded.
map_staff_only: The farm map is for extension officers and managers.
map_title: Map of farms and field signals
map_description: Farms with a saved location, crop stress from recent diagnoses, pest reports and soil data. Drag the globe to turn it.
map_note: Add a farmer’s location to put their farm on the map.
story_moisture: Holds most of the water roots reach
billing_no_plans: No plans can be bought online right now. Your current plan keeps working; contact your organisation to change it.
saliency_hint_lesions: Marked areas are where the model found damage. Point at one for detail.
saliency_hint_none: No damaged areas were marked on this photo.
sms_commands_intro: From {phone}, send PIN and your 4 digits once a day, then text any of these:
reports_none_match: No report title matches that search.
reports_open_failed: The report could not be opened. Try again.
reports_pdf_failed: The PDF could not be downloaded. Try again.
reports_no_text: This report has no text to show. The PDF may still hold it.
reports_export_failed: The export could not be downloaded. Try again.
reports_exports_body: CSV files in the layout national extension systems import. They hold only the farmers you can see, by reference number rather than name.
farmer_chat_no_officer: No officer is assigned to you yet. Your message will reach the next one assigned.
coverage_note: In {country}: weather, soil, satellite crop health and the AI agronomist; {prices}; SMS in {sms}.
coverage_prices_national: national yearly producer prices (no local markets yet)
settings_country_failed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
kb_guides_intro_officer: Add guides written for your area. A manager reviews each one before it is used in answers.
kb_guides_intro_reviewer: Guides added by officers and pages collected from the web are used in answers only after you approve them.
kb_guide_added: Guide added and ready to use in answers.
kb_guide_sent_for_review: Guide added. A manager will review it before it is used in answers.
kb_guide_upload_failed: Could not add the guide. Use a PDF, TXT or MD file with readable text.
kb_guide_approved: Guide approved. It is now used in answers.
kb_guide_list_failed: Could not load guides waiting for review.
kb_guide_none_pending: No guides are waiting for review.
kb_guide_review_failed: Could not save the decision. Try again.
sms_commands_whatsapp: The same commands work on WhatsApp from this number. There you can also send photos, a video or a voice note with VISIT 12, and they are added to the visit report.
sms_cmd_plan_notice: Schedule a visit: today, tomorrow, Tue or 25/11. The farmer is told by SMS
sms_cmd_reg: Register a farmer to you. They get a confirmation SMS
pilot_difference: The service group’s harvest changed by {diff} kg/ha more than the comparison group’s (95% range {low} to {high}).
pilot_method_note: Harvests are what farmers report by SMS; yields leave out farms without a recorded size. Have an independent evaluator check the method and the final numbers before you publish them.
pilot_no_difference: No difference to show yet: both groups need farmers who reported both harvests.
pilot_row_followed: Said they followed the advice (fully / partly)
pilot_too_early: Too early to draw a conclusion: each group needs at least {count} farmers with both harvests.
pilot_bag_kg: Kg in one bag, as farmers count it
pilot_action_failed: That did not work. Try again.
pilot_asked: Asked {sent} farmers. {skipped} could not be reached or turned notices off.
pilot_export: Data for the evaluator (CSV, no names)
pilot_heading: Pilots: does the service raise harvests?
pilot_intro: Farmers in a region are split at random into a service group and a comparison group. Both are asked for last season’s and this season’s harvest by SMS, and service-group farmers are asked whether they followed their officer’s advice.
pilot_none: No pilots yet. Create one for a region and a season.
pilot_started: Started: {service} farmers in the service group, {comparison} in the comparison group.
voice_called: Calling {queued} farmers. {skipped} calls could not be placed.
voice_calling_off: Calling farmers is not set up on this server yet.
voice_intro: Callers to the voice line hear these instead of the provider’s English voice. Advisories can be played to a running pilot’s service group by phone.
voice_prompt_advisory: An advisory to call farmers with
voice_read_this: Have a person read this, in the language:
voice_save_failed: Could not save the recording. Use an mp3 or wav file.
voice_transcript: What the recording says (for staff who do not speak the language)
kb_gaps_failed: Could not load the questions without a guide.
kb_gaps_none: Every question in the last 90 days had a vetted guide behind its answer.
diag_test_classes: Crops and problems in the test set
diag_test_empty: No labelled photos yet. Add some above.
diag_test_intro: A diagnosis is shown to farmers as tested only for a crop and problem with at least {samples} labelled photos, at least {accuracy}% of them diagnosed right. Every other diagnosis is marked for the officer to confirm. Officers add photos from farmers’ threads once they have confirmed the problem in the field.
diag_test_load_failed: Could not load the test set.
diag_test_mistakes: Photos the last test got wrong
diag_test_started: Testing {total} photos. Each one is an AI request.
diag_note_below: On {samples} labelled photos of this crop and problem it was right only {right}% of the time. Ask your officer to confirm before you treat.
diag_note_tested: Tested on {samples} labelled photos of this crop and problem: right {right}% of the time.
diag_note_untested: Not yet tested on labelled photos of this crop and problem. Ask your officer to confirm before you treat.
diag_label_failed: Could not save what the photo shows. Try again.
diag_label_problem: Problem you confirmed in the field (or healthy)
diag_label_saved: Saved. This photo now helps test photo diagnosis.
diag_test_files: Photos of one crop with one problem, confirmed by an agronomist
diag_test_partly_added: {added} of {total} photos added. The others could not be uploaded.
